mapper.sql: CASE WHEN d.total_amount <> 0 THEN i.amount / d.total_amount WHEN d.total_qty <> 0 THEN i.qty / d.total_qty ELSE 0 END

LEFT JOIN (SELECT source_id, SUM(bad_debt_amount * (amount - tax_amount) / amount) AS amount FROM fin_bill WHERE kind = 'AR' AND source_type = 'SALES_OUT' AND bad_debt_amount <> 0 AND amount <> 0 GROUP BY source_id) bd ON d.kind = 'SALES_OUT' AND bd.source_id = d.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT trade_doc_id, SUM(freight) AS amount FROM scm_shipment WHERE freight_bearer = 'COMPANY' AND status <> 'PENDING' AND freight > 0 GROUP BY trade_doc_id) sf ON d.kind = 'SALES_OUT' AND sf.trade_doc_id = d.id
mapper.select:
SELECT
d.partner_id AS "groupKey", c.name AS "groupName", t.period AS "groupKey", CAST(t.period AS CHAR) AS "groupName", i.material_id AS "groupKey", CONCAT(m.code, ' ', m.name) AS "groupName",
SUM(CASE WHEN d.kind = 'SALES_OUT' THEN i.qty ELSE -i.qty END) AS "qty", SUM(CASE WHEN d.kind = 'SALES_OUT' THEN 1 ELSE -1 END * (i.amount - i.tax_amount)) AS "revenue", SUM(CASE WHEN d.kind = 'SALES_OUT' THEN 1 ELSE -1 END * i.qty * COALESCE(mc.unit_cost, m.ref_cost, 0)) AS "cost", SUM(CASE WHEN mc.unit_cost IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "missingCost", SUM(COALESCE(bd.amount, 0) * ) AS "badDebt", SUM(COALESCE(sf.amount, 0) * ) AS "freight" FROM scm_trade_doc_item i JOIN scm_trade_doc d ON d.id = i.doc_id JOIN (SELECT id, YEAR(biz_date) * 100 + MONTH(biz_date) AS period FROM scm_trade_doc WHERE kind IN ('SALES_OUT', 'SALES_RETURN') AND biz_date >= #{begin} AND biz_date <= #{end}) t ON t.id = d.id JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = i.material_id LEFT JOIN scm_customer c ON c.id = d.partner_id LEFT JOIN fin_material_cost mc ON mc.material_id = i.material_id AND mc.period = t.period
WHERE 1 = 1 AND d.partner_id = #{customerId} GROUP BY
d.partner_id, c.name t.period i.material_id, m.code, m.name
ORDER BY t.period ORDER BY 4 DESC, 1
SELECT m.category AS "category", SUM(mc.close_amount) AS "closeAmount" FROM fin_material_cost mc JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = mc.material_id WHERE mc.period = #{period} GROUP BY m.category

SELECT q.material_id AS "materialId", m.code AS "code", m.name AS "name", q.cost_qty AS "costQty", q.stock_qty AS "stockQty" FROM ( SELECT x.material_id, SUM(x.cost_qty) AS cost_qty, SUM(x.stock_qty) AS stock_qty FROM ( SELECT material_id, close_qty AS cost_qty, 0 AS stock_qty FROM fin_material_cost WHERE period = #{period} UNION ALL SELECT f.material_id, 0, f.qty FROM wms_stock_flow f JOIN wms_warehouse wh ON wh.id = f.warehouse_id LEFT JOIN wms_stock_doc sd ON f.biz_type IN ('IN', 'OUT', 'TRANSFER') AND sd.id = f.doc_id LEFT JOIN wms_check ck ON f.biz_type = 'CHECK' AND ck.id = f.doc_id WHERE COALESCE(sd.biz_date, ck.biz_date) <= #{end} AND wh.type <> 'CONSIGN_IN' ) x GROUP BY x.material_id ) q JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = q.material_id WHERE q.cost_qty <> q.stock_qty ORDER BY m.code

SELECT e.voucher_id AS "voucherId", a.code AS "accountCode", e.debit AS "debit", e.credit AS "credit" FROM fin_voucher_entry e JOIN fin_voucher v ON v.id = e.voucher_id JOIN fin_account a ON a.id = e.account_id WHERE v.status = 'POSTED' AND v.period >= #{begin} AND v.period <= #{end} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fin_voucher_entry ce JOIN fin_account ca ON ca.id = ce.account_id WHERE ce.voucher_id = v.id AND ca.code LIKE CONCAT(#{c}, '%')) ORDER BY e.voucher_id, e.seq

SELECT s.voucher_id AS "voucherId", SUM(CASE WHEN b.source_type = 'ASSET' THEN si.amount ELSE 0 END) AS "assetAmount", SUM(si.amount) AS "totalAmount" FROM fin_settlement s JOIN fin_voucher v ON v.id = s.voucher_id JOIN fin_settlement_item si ON si.settlement_id = s.id JOIN fin_bill b ON b.id = si.bill_id WHERE s.kind = 'PAYMENT' AND v.status = 'POSTED' AND v.period >= #{begin} AND v.period <= #{end} GROUP BY s.voucher_id HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN b.source_type = 'ASSET' THEN si.amount ELSE 0 END) <> 0
